name: Leisure centre (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Sports and leisure centre, 52 x 34 m: a glazed single-storey front range (lobby with entrance canopy, cafe, office, weights room, first aid, changing rooms) before a tall 28 x 22 m sports hall in ribbed cladding with clerestories and a 24 x 22 m pool hall. The pool is a real sunken 16 x 11 m tank, tiled, 1.4 m deep with water, lane markings and ropes, steps in the shallow end, ladders, starting blocks and spectator seating; the sports hall has a court, backboards and bleachers; changing rooms have locker banks.
